text: The historical change fills out Thunderbird task-kind descriptions without changing graph code. Accepted source later uses kinds.md, while verify_kinds_docs and its registration are still commented out with a TODO. The document is useful navigation; its presence does not prove that completeness verification ran or that every task description matches execution. Review explicitly identified future enablement. No docs build or taskgraph generation ran.
title: Task-kind documentation does not enable its disabled completeness check
